credit: 32-token whole-network ATan-surrogate BPTT; all within-event physical ticks included
event_order: one sensory input pulse, quiet propagation, output read, next target revelation
physical_tick_unit: unchanged graph-delay tick; no physiological milliseconds inferred from OWT
writer_baseline: archived pulse update and zero-source decay at quiet ticks
physical_state: h, delayed STP pulses, ge, gi, ALIF b, STP x/u, sensory adaptation; never reset
evaluation: same active learner; pre-update window scores; fresh B and A revisit with actual bridges
optimizer_cadence: one joint update per 32 observed input events, including active evaluation

origin.initialization: born from scratch with GPT-2 embedding/unigram prior and LeJEPA Latent Predictor Form B

timing_migration.state_and_optimizer: all physical values, weights and Adam moments retained

training_data_policy: monotone fresh train cursor, no wrap/shuffle/epoch replay; evaluation replay excluded from training budget

first_pass_measurement.scope: every fresh training target scored before its update, including actual stream bridges; active B and A replay excluded
first_pass_measurement.ema_scope: historical EMA mixes training, fresh B and A replay traffic

dataset_manifest.boundary_policy: encode_ordinary(document) followed by GPT2 EOT; no state reset
